messages:
auditor_sam: Hi team — ISO fieldwork scheduled Monday. Request: an evidence bundle that ties RBAC edits (k8s RoleBinding/ClusterRoleBinding + IAM policy updates) to KMS Decrypt/GenerateDataKey events for the window 2025-07-02T00:00Z -> 2025-07-05T00:00Z. Must include chain-of-custody (signed manifest + per-file SHA256) and a control map to SOC2 CC6/CC7 and ISO A.9/A.12.

olivia: Got it. Quick clarifier: include admin console actions and terraform apply diffs? Also EKM/HSM logs if present?

auditor_sam: Yes to admin console and terraform. EKM optional; start with CMKs. One consolidated bundle across prod regions is fine.

noah: Approach: 1) export CloudTrail (Decrypt, GenerateDataKey, ReEncrypt, CreateGrant), 2) k8s audit for RBAC object changes, 3) admin-ui audit and terraform run logs, 4) correlate and compute correlation_score. We'll include raw + redacted copies.

olivia: Splunk snippets I plan to run (prod):
```spl
index=cloudtrail (eventName=Decrypt OR eventName=GenerateDataKey OR eventName=ReEncrypt OR eventName=CreateGrant)
| eval ts=_time
| table ts, eventName, userIdentity.arn, requestParameters.keyId, requestParameters.keyAlias, sourceIPAddress, userAgent
| sort ts
```

```spl
index=k8s_audit (objectRef.resource=rolebindings OR objectRef.resource=clusterrolebindings)
| table _time, user.username, verb, objectRef.resource, objectRef.name, requestObject
```

```spl
index=admin_ui_audit OR index=terraform_runs
| table _time, actor, action_type, details
```

noah: Correlation rules (scoring): time_delta (weight 45), token_issuer_match (30), ip_useragent_match (15), infra_ref_match (10). score normalized 0-1. We'll include scoring_rules.md showing pseudocode.

auditor_sam: Also need incident linkage: there was a brief incident INC-20250703-7 during the window (scale-controller rollback). Please annotate rows tied to that incident and show who triggered RBAC changes and whether ephemeral keys (alias/ephemeral/*) were used.

olivia: Will do. Staging (unsigned) bundle path: s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1867007777-keyproof-bundle.zip. Contents: cloudtrail.csv, k8s_audit.csv, admin_ui.csv, terraform_runs.csv, correlation.csv, scoring_rules.md, control_map.md, manifest.json. We'll sign manifest.json with KMS signing key alias/audit-sign and produce manifest.json.sig, then move to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1867007777/.

noah: Pseudo-SQL join I'll run in analytics: 
```sql
SELECT
  r._time AS rb_time,
  r.user_username AS rb_actor,
  r.objectRef_name AS rb_object,
  r.verb AS rb_change_type,
  k.ts AS kms_time,
  k.userIdentity_arn AS kms_actor,
  k.requestParameters_keyId AS key_id,
  k.requestParameters_keyAlias AS key_alias,
  compute_score(...) AS correlation_score,
  inc.incident_id AS incident_id,
  's3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1867007777/manifest.json.sig' AS manifest_ref
FROM k8s_audit r
LEFT JOIN cloudtrail k ON abs(r._time - k.ts) <= 240
LEFT JOIN admin_ui_audit a ON a._time BETWEEN r._time - 300 AND r._time + 300
LEFT JOIN terraform_runs t ON t.run_window OVERLAPS r._time
LEFT JOIN incident_index inc ON inc.window CONTAINS r._time;
```

olivia: Signing flow we'll run: 
```bash
aws s3 cp ./1867007777-keyproof-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/temp/
aws kms sign --key-id alias/audit-sign --message fileb://manifest.json --signature fileb://manifest.json.sig
aws s3 mv s3://redwood-compliance/temp/1867007777-keyproof-bundle.zip s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1867007777-keyproof-bundle.zip
```

auditor_sam: ETA for signed bundle? Also please include a small sanitized example row in the README so we can confirm format.

noah: ETA ~5 hours. We'll DM presigned link when done. Sample sanitized row (emails redacted, ids truncated):
"rbac_1720001110 | eve[at]redwood (redacted) | RoleBinding:scale-controller | patch | kms_1720001142 | svc-account-scale | key/abcd-xxxx | alias/ephemeral/scale | 0.91 | INC-20250703-7 | s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/1867007777/manifest.json.sig"

oncall-bot: INCIDENT 2025-07-03T02:18Z - scale-controller rollback recorded. ID: INC-20250703-7

auditor_sam: Thanks — that'll work. We'll review on receipt and request ekm_audit if needed. :thumbsup:
